_comment: Copy to checksums.json, fill every value with a real lowercase SHA-256 (64 hex chars), then pass it as -ChecksumFile to bootstrap.ps1. Empty values FAIL CLOSED on purpose: no hash in this repo was invented. Keys are the exact downloaded file names, so bumping a version parameter invalidates its pin automatically.
_source_vs_BuildTools: https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vs_BuildTools.exe -- Microsoft publishes no per-build hash; pin the bytes you fetched (change detector, not supply-chain proof).
_source_python: https://www.python.org/ftp/python/<PythonVersion>/python-<PythonVersion>-amd64.exe -- python.org publishes an MD5, a GPG signature (<file>.asc) and a sigstore bundle, not a SHA-256. Verify the signature first, then pin the SHA-256 of the file you verified.
_source_nsis: SourceForge file listing for NSIS 3/<NsisVersion> shows the SHA-256
_source_webview2: https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?LinkId=2124703 -- Evergreen bootstrapper, no published per-build hash; same caveat as vs_BuildTools.exe.
